author: Maddie Taylor Hartley
title: Warehouses Swarm The Woodlands As Office Projects Dry Up - NewsBreak
text:
By Maddie Taylor Hartley ,
14 hours ago The Woodlands is shifting from a corporate-office focus to more industrial development, with 25 industrial buildings under construction in late December—up from 15 a year earlier—driven by demand from logistics, life-science manufacturing, and corporate relocations in the northern Houston suburbs. While local rents for office, retail, and industrial space all increased year over year, industrial occupancy dipped slightly, indicating a changing demand for the types of space the area will need in the future.
